items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: when I went in with Lunceford's band, there was two of us went in there together. Saxophone player named Teddy Buckner from Detroit, Milt Buckner's brother.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a lot of fun though down there. But when I left Earl, I went to New York then to join Lunceford. And
when I went in with Lunceford's band, there was two of us went in there together. Saxophone player named Teddy Buckner from Detroit, Milt Buckner's brother.
A saxophone player named Teddy Buckner?
